AA.physical_anchor: Mines bauxite and refines/smelts it into alumina and aluminum ingot/billet.
AA.value_chain_position: Vertically integrated bauxite mining -> alumina refining -> aluminum smelting; sells alumina and primary aluminum.

AAUC.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré at open-pit/underground operations in Cote d'Ivoire, Mali and Ethiopia.
AAUC.value_chain_position: Emerging mid-tier gold producer selling doré/bullion from West/East Africa mines.

AEM.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold (with silver/copper/zinc byproduct) at Canadian, Mexican and Finnish mines.
AEM.value_chain_position: Senior gold producer selling refined bullion plus byproduct base metals.

AG.physical_anchor: Mines and processes silver-gold ore into doré/concentrate at Mexican and US mines.
AG.value_chain_position: Silver-primary producer with gold byproduct; sells doré and concentrate.

AGI.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré/bullion at open-pit and underground mines in Canada, Mexico and Turkey.
AGI.value_chain_position: Mid-tier gold producer selling refined bullion.

ARIS.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré at Segovia and Marmato underground mines in Colombia.
ARIS.value_chain_position: Latin America-focused underground gold producer selling doré.

ASM.physical_anchor: Mines and processes silver-gold-copper-lead-zinc ore into concentrate/doré at Mexican mines.
ASM.value_chain_position: Small-cap silver-gold producer selling concentrate and doré.

AU.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré at mines across South Africa, Ghana, Guinea, Tanzania, DRC and Egypt.
AU.value_chain_position: Senior African-focused gold producer selling refined bullion.

AUGO.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré plus copper-gold-silver concentrate (Aranzazu, Mexico) across Brazil, Honduras and Mexico.
AUGO.value_chain_position: Latin American multi-mine producer selling gold doré and copper concentrate.

AVNT.physical_anchor: None identifiable — compounds and colors plastic resins into engineered polymer formulations; does not mine, refine or move any chain commodity.
AVNT.value_chain_position: Specialty polymer formulator/colorant supplier (ex-PolyOne); caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string, not a rare-earth/strategic-metals name.

AXTA.physical_anchor: None identifiable — formulates and sells liquid and powder coatings (automotive refinish/OEM, industrial paint); no mined-commodity link.
AXTA.value_chain_position: Global coatings/paint formulator; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string, not a rare-earth/strategic-metals name.

AYA.physical_anchor: Mines and processes silver ore into concentrate/doré at the Zgounder and Boumadine mines in Morocco.
AYA.value_chain_position: Silver-primary producer selling concentrate/doré from Moroccan mines.

B.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré plus copper concentrate/cathode at mines including Lumwana (Zambia) and Zaldívar (Chile).
B.value_chain_position: Senior gold producer with a growing copper segment; sells bullion and copper concentrate/cathode.

BCPC.physical_anchor: None identifiable — manufactures choline chloride, encapsulated micronutrients and specialty performance ingredients for feed/food/industrial customers; no mined-commodity link.
BCPC.value_chain_position: Specialty nutrition/performance-ingredients chemicals maker; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string, not a rare-earth/strategic-metals name.

BHP.physical_anchor: Mines and ships copper concentrate/cathode (Escondida) and iron ore, met coal and potash from operations across Australia, Chile and Canada.
BHP.value_chain_position: Multi-commodity major (copper, iron ore, met coal, potash) selling raw ore/concentrate; no rare-earth production despite the industry-filter hint.

BTG.physical_anchor: Mines and pours gold doré at open-pit mines in Mali, Namibia and the Philippines.
BTG.value_chain_position: Mid-tier gold producer selling refined bullion from a globally diversified mine portfolio.

BVN.physical_anchor: Mines and processes silver-gold ore into concentrate/doré at Peruvian mines, plus a 19.3% equity stake in the Cerro Verde copper mine.
BVN.value_chain_position: Peruvian precious/base-metals producer; consolidated revenue is mostly silver/gold, with copper exposure carried as an equity-method affiliate (Cerro Verde), not consolidated sales.

CBT.physical_anchor: None identifiable — manufactures carbon black and fumed metal-oxide specialty chemicals for rubber/coatings customers; no mined-commodity link.
CBT.value_chain_position: Carbon black / specialty chemicals producer; caught by the 'Chemicals - Specialty' industry string, not a rare-earth/strategic-metals name.

CCJ.physical_anchor: Mines uranium ore, mills/converts it into U3O8 and UF6, and fabricates nuclear fuel at Canadian and US facilities.
CCJ.value_chain_position: Vertically integrated uranium miner/converter/fuel-services provider; also holds a 49% Westinghouse nuclear-services equity stake that dilutes pure uranium revenue share.

CDE.physical_anchor: Mines and processes silver-gold ore into doré/concentrate at US and Mexican mines.
CDE.value_chain_position: US-focused silver-gold producer selling doré and concentrate.
